query: I want to build a Next.js app where users sign up with email and get their own Ethereum wallet. Walk me through the full setup.
expected_behavior: Recommends Auth Proxy path as the simplest architecture
Shows TurnkeyProvider setup with emailOtpAuthEnabled and createSuborgParams
Configures wallet provisioning at signup with ETH account in createSuborgParams
Delegates to authenticating-users-sdk for auth details and creating-wallets-sdk for chain support
Shows the login page with handleLogin and the dashboard with wallet access

query: Build me a crypto app with Google OAuth login and both Ethereum and Solana wallets for each user. I want users to be able to sign messages and send transactions.
expected_behavior: Configures OAuth with Google client ID in the provider
Sets up createSuborgParams with both ETH and SOL wallet accounts
Shows signMessage usage for both chains via useTurnkey hook
Shows signAndSendTransaction for sending transactions with RPC URL
Mentions checking signing-transactions-sdk for advanced chain-specific patterns

query: I need a custodial wallet app where my backend controls user wallets but users can also sign in and view their balances. How should I architect this with Turnkey?
expected_behavior: Recommends the hybrid/delegated access pattern
Shows creating sub-org with both delegated API key and end user as root users
Creates scoped policies to restrict what the backend key can do
Removes delegated key from root quorum after policy setup
Delegates to managing-policies-sdk for policy syntax details

query: Walk me through adding Turnkey embedded wallets to my existing Next.js React app. I already have a login page but need to add wallet functionality.
expected_behavior: Starts with installing @turnkey/react-wallet-kit
